about: Hotel logos of the free hotel list cards (cream logo column) and the tourism marks of their foot. Each file is copied unaltered from the official source named here (the hotel, its chain or its press room, the tourism body, or Wikimedia Commons); a file supplied for the cards (a one-colour or light-ground version of a hotel’s own logo) says so in its origin. Load through only, never inline (some SVGs carry generic
